You will need: List of formulae (MF19)
INSTRUCTIONS
/solidcircleAnswer all questions.
/solidcircleUse a black or dark blue pen. You may use an HB pencil for any diagrams or graphs.
/solidcircleWrite your name, centre number and candidate number in the boxes at the top of the page.
/solidcircleWrite your answer to each question in the space provided.
/solidcircleDo not use an erasable pen or correction fluid.
/solidcircleDo not write on any bar codes.
/solidcircleIf additional space is needed, you should use the lined page at the end of this booklet; the question
number or numbers must be clearly shown.
/solidcircleYou should use a calculator where appropriate.
/solidcircleYou must show all necessary working clearly; no marks will begiven for unsupported answers from a
calculator.
/solidcircleGive non-exact numerical answers correct to 3 significant figures, or 1 decimal place for angles in
degrees, unless a different level of accuracy is specified in the question.
INFORMATION
/solidcircleThe total mark for this paper is 75.
/solidcircleThe number of marks for each question or part question is shown in brackets [ ].
